nodes.name: EasyPost Tracker Webhook
nodes.notes: Put this node's PRODUCTION URL on the EasyPost webhook (with a webhook secret). Answers 200 at once so EasyPost does not retry on our latency.

nodes.name: Send Event to ERPNext
nodes.notes: Guest + HMAC endpoint — no ERPNext API key needed. Body must be sent as the exact signed string (specifyBody=string), not re-serialized JSON. Set n8n variable ERPNEXT_BASE_URL (e.g. https://illumenatelighting.v.frappe.cloud).
